products.name: Epic AI (SlicerDicer, etc.)
products.note: Clinical decision support; patient data exposure; HIPAA critical; FDA SaMD considerations

profile_text.body:
Epic Systems is a healthcare software company founded in 1979, originally in a basement, that describes itself as developing software to help people get well, stay well, and help future generations be healthier. The company builds electronic health record and clinical workflow tools used by large health systems across the United States.

Epic offers AI capabilities embedded in its platform, tracked here under the product grouping Epic AI, which includes tools such as SlicerDicer and features oriented toward clinical decision support. One set of functions supports the outpatient office visit by helping clinicians arrive prepared, anticipating needs during the encounter, and lining up documentation and orders for review before the visit ends. Another feature, called Insights, generates AI-produced chart summaries to help clinicians get up to speed quickly. Organizations including Mayo Clinic, Parkview Health, and Riverside Health use Insights. Mayo Clinic clinicians reported a 17% reduction in cognitive load, Riverside clinicians spent 23% less time reading notes, and Parkview clinicians spent 13% less time in Chart Review. Epic also offers a nursing documentation tool called Chart with Art, which nurses at Mount Sinai Medical Center in Florida have adopted for AI-assisted charting.

The held facts note that Epic AI carries considerations around patient data exposure, HIPAA compliance, and FDA Software as a Medical Device classifications, reflecting the regulatory sensitivity of AI embedded in clinical workflows. No litigation or MCP registry presence is recorded in the current holdings.
